status: written after seeing the A-L1 results (declared)
what_was_seen: A-L1 (tighter projector quadrature) did NOT cure 2S at theta 0.05 (it got worse: ln k0(300 Ry) diff +1.91 instead of +1.00), so the A-L1 diagnosis (projector leak) was wrong or incomplete. New diagnosis (measured with eigs on the p-channel walk): the spectrum of W/lambda_n is mirrored (doubler partner at phase +pi). The state degenerate with 2S (2P_1/2: |W/lambda - 1| = 1.6e-10 at theta 0.05, 1.4e-9 at 0.1) has a mirror at |W/lambda + 1| = 1.6e-10, i.e. at the pole of the Cayley T = i(W/l - 1)(W/l + 1)^-1: any tiny weight of the source there is amplified ~1e10. For 1S the nearest is 1e-6 (harmless).
change: same method and numerics as A-L1, plus explicit removal (orthogonal projection, W unitary) of the 6 eigenvectors of W/lambda_n nearest to -1 from the projected source, before the Cayley transform. Same exams and thresholds; results in lab/out/vuoto_f2_bethe_A2.json, reported next to the pre-registered and A-L1 ones; NOT graded (the verdict stays L1, L2, L3 FAIL).
